svg.title: dsh-canteen-retention-check structure: two moments, 48-hour window, cross-table bypass
svg.desc: The retention ledger is parsed into canonical fields; eight rules check the sampling moment and CF-006 checks the 48-hour release floor; CF-010 needs a second ledger and lands in skipped[] when only one is supplied; findings merge into issues[] and skipped[].

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: One ledger row, two moments, ten rules

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: Sampling checks four elements, 125 g, minute precision, template leftovers and future dates; release checks the 48-hour floor.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: A missing column skips the whole rule — never a per-row report. CF-010 is the only cross-table rule.
